description: Report connections whose access token has expired or is about to, and which therefore need the user to reconnect. Check this before scheduling anything far out - a post scheduled onto a dead connection fails silently at publish time.

workspaceId.description: Workspace (project) id to act on, from list_workspaces. Omit to use the caller's default workspace. Always pass this when the user belongs to more than one workspace.

name: get_account_health
